latest_request: Bottle first image is still poorly localized; do not mistake occlusion correction for accurate pose
status: Partial visual improvement only. Original approved poses/renders preserved; no production replacement or publication.

occlusion.method: Joint SAM2.1-large visible-instance labels for hands, bottle, cap, chopsticks. Native 1920x1080 input; 960x540 labels/composite.
occlusion.validation: All 33 frames of each clip: source/pose indices agree, only object-mask/robot intersection changes, frozen input SHA256 unchanged.
occlusion.limitation: Transfers source image visibility, not metric depth or true contact. Thin-object masks and differences between human/robot geometry remain imperfect. SAM compiled hole-filling extension unavailable; inference succeeded.

diagnosis.meaning: Small fingertip pseudo-target residual does not imply correct palm, wrist or human alignment. Robot base and human anatomical wrist are not identical landmarks. Hidden fingers are estimates, not observed ground truth.

alignment.method: Custom native-size bounded coordinate-descent fitting of visible hand silhouette, weak WiLoR pixel anchors, object-excluded mask and wrist-side forearm exclusion. V3 Gaussian-filters ONLY added pose corrections (sigma 1 frame), accepts when per-frame composite objective improves.
alignment.camera: Unchanged WiLoR virtual camera; not physical world coordinates
alignment.caution: These IoUs use the same SAM masks optimized against, not independent validation. Two right-hand frames regress in IoU despite improved combined objective. Do not call this universally better or fully solved.
alignment.temporal: V2 increased projected-joint acceleration; V3 reduced that increase but does not eliminate it. Left mean acceleration 5.90 -> 6.27 and right 14.36 -> 14.47 px/frame^2. This includes actual motion and is not isolated jitter.
alignment.visual: Inspected all V2 frames as contact sheets, V3 start/middle/end. Palm outline improves modestly; residual human pixels, morphology differences and inaccurate grasp placement remain.
alignment.duration: 33 frames at 15 fps, 2.2 seconds, unchanged source timing

tests: 9 passed in compare-env: occlusion invariants, joint mapping, virtual/native FK correspondence; no joint-limit violation in the new pilot. No physical contact or human-label accuracy test.
preservation: No training jobs touched, no remote machines used, no server started, no commit or push. All own exec jobs completed.
